local instance = nil
local Game = {}

function newGame()
  instance = Game:new()

  instance:addCategory("Castle Kits", {"Flappy", "Ranker", "Maze Villain", "Golf Course"})
  instance:addCategory("Castle Badges", {"Introduced", "Promoter", "Addicting", "Responsive"})
  instance:addCategory("Castle Default Blueprints", {"Creature", "Ball", "Wall", "Collectible"})
  instance:addCategory("Castle Music Tool Presets", {"Techno", "8-bit", "Prelude", "808"})

  instance:start()
end

local CELL_SIZE = 2
local CELL_PADDING = (10 - 4.0 * CELL_SIZE) / 5.0
local TEXT_HORIZONTAL_PADDING = 0
local TEXT_VERTICAL_PADDING = 0.42
local SHADOW_OFFSET_X = 0.05
local SHADOW_OFFSET_Y = 0.08

function shuffleInPlace(t)
  for i = #t, 2, -1 do
    local j = math.random(i)
    t[i], t[j] = t[j], t[i]
  end
end

function Game:new()
  local obj = {
    categories = {},
    createdActors = {},
  }
  setmetatable(obj, self)
  self.__index = self
  return obj
end

function Game:addCategory(description, words)
  table.insert(self.categories, {
      description = description,
      words = words,
    })
end

function Game:alert(text)
  self.alertActor.text.content = text
  castle.runAfterDelay(2.0, function()
      if self.alertActor.text.content == text then
        self.alertActor.text.content = ""
      end
    end)
end

function Game:start()
  my.layout.visible = false
  self.alertActor = castle.closestActorWithTag("alert")
  self.alertActor.text.content = ""
  self.alertActor.layout.y = -5.4

  self.words = {}
  self.completedCategories = {}

  for i, category in ipairs(self.categories) do
    for _, word in ipairs(category.words) do
      table.insert(self.words, {
          word = word,
          categoryIdx = i,
        })
    end
  end

  shuffleInPlace(self.words)

  self.shadowActors = {}
  self.cellActors = {}
  self.textActors = {}
  for x = 1, 4 do
    self.shadowActors[x] = {}
    self.cellActors[x] = {}
    self.textActors[x] = {}

    for y = 1, 4 do
      local xPos = -5.0 + (x - 1) * (CELL_SIZE + CELL_PADDING) + CELL_SIZE * 0.5 + CELL_PADDING
      local yPos = -5.0 + (y - 1) * (CELL_SIZE + CELL_PADDING) + CELL_SIZE * 0.5 + CELL_PADDING

      local shadowActor = castle.createActor("Cell", xPos + SHADOW_OFFSET_X, yPos + SHADOW_OFFSET_Y)
      shadowActor.layout.widthScale = CELL_SIZE
      shadowActor.layout.heightScale = CELL_SIZE
      shadowActor.drawing.currentFrame = 3
      self.shadowActors[x][y] = shadowActor
      
      local cellActor = castle.createActor("Cell", xPos, yPos)
      cellActor.layout.widthScale = CELL_SIZE
      cellActor.layout.heightScale = CELL_SIZE
      self.cellActors[x][y] = cellActor

      local textActor = castle.createActor("Text", xPos + TEXT_HORIZONTAL_PADDING, yPos + TEXT_VERTICAL_PADDING)
      textActor.text.content = ""
      textActor.layout.widthScale = CELL_SIZE - (TEXT_HORIZONTAL_PADDING * 2.0)
      textActor.layout.heightScale = CELL_SIZE - (TEXT_VERTICAL_PADDING * 2.0)
      self.textActors[x][y] = textActor

      table.insert(self.createdActors, shadowActor)
      table.insert(self.createdActors, cellActor)
      table.insert(self.createdActors, textActor)
    end
  end

  self:layout()
end

function Game:cleanup()
  for _, actor in ipairs(self.createdActors) do
    castle.destroyActor(actor)
  end
end

function Game:layout()
  local wordIndex = 1
  self.positionToWord = {}

  for x = 1, 4 do
    self.positionToWord[x] = {}
  end

  -- y on the outside so that wordIndex is row first
  for y = 1, 4 do
    for x = 1, 4 do
      if y <= #self.completedCategories then
        self.shadowActors[x][y].layout.visible = false
        self.cellActors[x][y].layout.visible = false
        self.textActors[x][y].layout.visible = false
      else
        self.cellActors[x][y].drawing.currentFrame = 1
        self.textActors[x][y].text.content = self.words[wordIndex].word
        self.positionToWord[x][y] = self.words[wordIndex]
        wordIndex = wordIndex + 1
      end
    end
  end
end

function Game:handleTap(x, y)
  local frame = self.cellActors[x][y].drawing.currentFrame
  if frame == 1 then
    frame = 2
  else
    frame = 1
  end
  self.cellActors[x][y].drawing.currentFrame = frame
  self:checkForEndOfTurn()
end

function Game:addCompletedRow(categoryIdx)
  local rowNumber = #self.completedCategories

  local yPos = -5.0 + (rowNumber - 1) * (CELL_SIZE + CELL_PADDING) + CELL_SIZE * 0.5 + CELL_PADDING

  local shadowActor = castle.createActor("CompletedCell", SHADOW_OFFSET_X, yPos + SHADOW_OFFSET_Y)
  shadowActor.drawing.currentFrame = 5
  shadowActor.layout.widthScale = 4.67
  shadowActor.layout.heightScale = 4.67
  
  local cellActor = castle.createActor("CompletedCell", 0, yPos)
  cellActor.drawing.currentFrame = categoryIdx
  cellActor.layout.widthScale = 4.67
  cellActor.layout.heightScale = 4.67

  local titleActor = castle.createActor("CompletedText", 0, yPos + 0.25)
  titleActor.text.content = self.categories[categoryIdx].description
  titleActor.layout.widthScale = 8

  local wordsActor = castle.createActor("CompletedText", 0, yPos + 0.9)
  wordsActor.text.content = table.concat(self.categories[categoryIdx].words, ", ")
  wordsActor.layout.widthScale = 8

  table.insert(self.createdActors, shadowActor)
  table.insert(self.createdActors, cellActor)
  table.insert(self.createdActors, titleActor)
  table.insert(self.createdActors, wordsActor)
end

function Game:checkForEndOfTurn()
  local selectedWords = {}

  for x = 1, 4 do
    for y = 1, 4 do
      local isSelected = math.fmod(self.cellActors[x][y].drawing.currentFrame, 2) == 0
      if isSelected then
        table.insert(selectedWords, self.positionToWord[x][y])
      end
    end
  end

  if #selectedWords >= 4 then
    local categoryIdx = selectedWords[1].categoryIdx
    local isMatch = true
    for i = 2, 4 do
      if selectedWords[i].categoryIdx ~= categoryIdx then
        isMatch = false
      end
    end

    if isMatch then
      table.insert(self.completedCategories, categoryIdx)

      local newWords = {}
      for _, word in ipairs(self.words) do
        if word.categoryIdx ~= categoryIdx then
          table.insert(newWords, word)
        end
      end
      self.words = newWords

      if #self.completedCategories == 4 then
        self.alertActor.text.content = "You win!"
      else
        self:alert("Correct!")
      end
      self:addCompletedRow(categoryIdx)
    else
      self:alert("Try again")
    end

    self:layout()
  end
end

function onCreate()
  newGame()
end

function onUpdate(dt)

end

function onMessage(message, triggeringActor)
  if message == "cellTap" then
    for x = 1, 4 do
      for y = 1, 4 do
        if triggeringActor == instance.cellActors[x][y] then
          instance:handleTap(x, y)
        end
      end
    end
  elseif message == "restart" then
    if instance ~= nil then
      instance:cleanup()
    end
    newGame()
  end
end
